headline: More Than 6,000 Loans Awarded to Young People for Apartments! Vučić: We Are Continuing This Measure
summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić said more than 6,000 loans for young people have been awarded for subsidised apartment purchases. He said the state will continue the measure.
why: Subsidised mortgage programmes affect housing demand, construction activity and the banks that provide the loans.
